# Object evidence matrix (E2)

<!-- Generated by `scripts/audit_object_matrix.py`. Do not hand-edit. -->

One row per OBJT object in `full_ir.json`, aggregating the per-CODE
axes of `semantic-coverage.md` into a per-object audit view. Column
meaning and boundaries are in the generator's docstring; the short
form: `c`/`t`/`s` = cited in contracts/tests/src, `e` = env_classified,
`u` = uncited, `executed` = entered by the full-suite ledger,
`pending` = with-pending environment sites. Execution is evidence a body
ran, not behavioural equivalence; the old CFG ledger's semantics/behaviour
columns are frozen 2026-09 data and are not read here.
